title: Self-blame and worthlessness are interconnected with procrastination and body image issues
Struggling with behavior change and procrastination are linked to relationship distress and self-blame
Negative self-criticism and self-blame are closely tied to feelings of worthlessness and body image issues
Relationship distress and lack of sympathy from others are related to self-blame and negative self-criticism
Difficulty with self-compassion and emotional regulation are underlying struggles
